description:
"We're going to keep clinging to each other like dogs in heat—"
That flimsy word first love isn't nearly enough to describe it.
Seo Nayoon left Do Jinhan half-ruined, emotionally wrecked.
"Do Jinhan. Please, just pretend you don’t know me."
With those absurd words, I disappeared from his life…
